transcript:
Meeting header: 2025-01-15 16:00 UTC | Duration: 45 minutes | Attendees: Ava Chen, Liam Torres, Priya Singh, Sam Novak, Maya Patel, Carlos Rivera, Jordan Lee, Elena Park, Devon Brooks

Summary: quick internal ops checkin, mostly SOC2 evidence, finance month end, laptop refresh, and K M S vendor follow ups.

[00:00] Ava Chen: Okay folks, thanks for joining, quick roll call. I see Maya, Carlos, Jordan, Priya, Liam. Can everyone hear me?
[00:07] Maya Patel: Yep, hearing you.
[00:10] Carlos Rivera: Here.
[00:12] Jordan Lee: Present.
[00:15] Priya Singh: Here, sorry running a bit behind.
[00:18] Liam Torres: Good afternoon.
[00:20] Sam Novak: Sam here.
[00:23] Ava Chen: Great. Agenda we have SOC2 evidence gaps, KMS/HSM vendor questions, laptop refresh plan and finance invoicing timing. We'll keep to 45 minutes.

[00:40] Priya Singh: I'll start with SOC2. I pulled the evidence tracker, there are about six items outstanding for control CC6 and a couple documentation items for change management. I flagged the vendor access logs and a missing restore test for one of the backup targets.
[00:55] Maya Patel: On the restore test, that's on the runbook side, we had a partial failover test in November but the screenshots weren't uploaded to the evidence folder, I can pull them and drop in the folder.
[01:12] Priya Singh: Perfect, if you can add the screenshots and timestamps that covers one of the gaps. Also the K V cache diagram that the infra team maintains is slightly out of date - it references the old cluster names.
[01:27] Liam Torres: Yeah that's on me, the diagram generator script pointed at staging, I forgot to re-run it after infra rename. I'll regenerate and push the svg and a PDF. Expect that by Monday.
[01:40] Carlos Rivera: Quick finance note - we need final PO numbers for the Dedicated contract renewal by next Friday to hit month-end accounting. Who's owning that?
[01:50] Jordan Lee: Procurement can chase the PO but we need finance sign-off on the new terms. Carlos, can you confirm the cutoff?
[01:58] Carlos Rivera: Cutoff is 2025-01-29 for invoice inclusion in January close, but we need to have POs in place by 1/24 to start the procurement workflow.
[02:10] Jordan Lee: Okay I'll put that in the calendar and spin up the PR.

[02:25] Ava Chen: Back to security, Priya you also had a question about K M S integrations?
[02:30] Priya Singh: Yes, we're trying to finalize the KMS/HSM shortlist. I have three vendors but we need answers on key wrapping, BYOK flows, HSM FIPS certs, and if they support customer-managed keys for the private deployment. Also ask about audit logging retention and whether the vendor stores metadata outside region.
[02:50] Elena Park: From legal perspective, please include explicit questions about subprocessor lists and data residency in the questionnaire, we had an issue last quarter with incomplete subproc disclosures.
[02:58] Priya Singh: Good call, I'll add that.
[03:05] Maya Patel: One more operational note, laptop refresh - we budgeted for 60 seats this quarter but procurement lead times are about 4–6 weeks for the M series builds. We need to tag assets and ensure encrypted disk images are baked before shipping.
[03:22] Devon Brooks: On the SRE side, please ensure the disk encryption uses company K M S and the machine identity provisioning ties to Okta. We had a drift issue where a few machines had local admin enabled during staging.
[03:35] Priya Singh: Is that the one where the AMIs were built without the updated script?
[03:38] Devon Brooks: Exactly, the image builder job didn't pick up the new AMI recipe.
[03:42] Liam Torres: We can add a post-build validation step in the pipeline to check for local admin and ensured disk encryption flags. I'll file a ticket.

[03:58] Carlos Rivera: Back to finance, we also need clarity on the new usage billing model for hosted API for the PLG team. Are we switching to per-token tiers next month? That impacts forecast.
[04:10] Ava Chen: That's a product decision, but finance needs an internal brief. Sam, can you coordinate a short note with estimated ranges?
[04:16] Sam Novak: Yep I can do a two slide brief and circulate.
[04:20] Carlos Rivera: Great, that will help AR.

[04:32] Jordan Lee: Procurement question — for HSM we may need on-prem appliance quotes vs cloud HSM. Lead time for appliance procurement is longer and requires rack space approval. Do we have the space booked?
[04:42] Maya Patel: Not yet, I'll check with facilities but that usually takes 2 weeks for approval. If we go appliance path we'll need fast-tracked approvals.

[05:00] Priya Singh: On SOC2 evidence, I will mark the controls that are at risk and propose a remediation plan. Priya: action items: I will upload missing logs and call out remaining CCB artifacts.
[05:14] Ava Chen: Good. For vendor questionnaire, let's standardize one template. I'll draft and send to Jordan and Priya for procurement/legal review.
[05:22] Elena Park: Please include contract term questions and indemnity language flags so legal can triage.

[05:30] Liam Torres: Quick tech item — backup target restore test, do we have the runbook for the cloud backup? I remember an S3 lifecycle confusion where old snapshots were archived and needed restore from glacier like tier.
[05:44] Maya Patel: Right, the lifecycle policy was applied in error last year. We reverted but need to document the restore time and provide proof for SOC2. I'll capture the runbook steps and timestamps.

[06:00] Carlos Rivera: Any blockers on invoices? If not, I'll prepare the January accrual entry and send it for sign-off.
[06:08] Ava Chen: Sounds good Carlos, please share the deadline and the sign-off owners.
[06:12] Carlos Rivera: I'll send calendar with PO deadlines and approvers.

[06:20] Sam Novak: I'll do the billing note and include expected ranges for the usage model.
[06:24] Ava Chen: Okay let's recap decisions and owners. Priya will upload SOC2 artifacts and compile a gap list, due 01/20. Maya will add restore screenshots and start laptop PR due 01/22. Carlos will circulate PO cutoff calendar by 01/17. Ava will draft vendor questionnaire and send to procurement/legal by 01/18. Sam will create billing brief by 01/18. Jordan will open procurement PR and track lead times.

[06:48] Jordan Lee: Does anyone have questions on procurement path? Otherwise I'll assume appliance vs cloud will be evaluated once questionnaire returns.
[06:55] Ava Chen: No questions. Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene next week same time if needed.
[07:02] Priya Singh: Thanks.
[07:04] Maya Patel: Thanks all.
[07:06] End of transcript.
